method: built-in image_gen, one asset per call

tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fresh full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Aether from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is the official portrait, guiding identity, costume and polished anime illustration style; image 2 is the user-provided in-game model, guiding face, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories and colors. Faithfully preserve these details, translating the model into the illustrated style of the official portrait. Petite Medium Male proportions. Relaxed, friendly standing pose facing generally toward the viewer, both arms naturally lowered at his sides. For his face, follow the in-game model closely: matching golden amber irises, each with a single small dark pupil within the iris, clear upper and lower eyelids and a natural shared gaze. Draw one complete, distinct eye on each side of the face with consistent shape and scale; preserve ordinary anime eye anatomy and keep the iris and pupil clean and simple. Hair and clothing hang naturally. Each hand has a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb with natural articulation, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. One coherent mouth and neutral expression. No weapon. Full silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes visible with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. Polished anime game artwork on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
